name: LabDemo Rules
description: Representative domain rule pack for LabDemo X-ray inspection control and data pipeline

rules.title: Hardware Communication Authority
rules.description: Hardware communication and direct driver control must strictly reside in service/hardware layer modules. UI, view models, and orchestrators must never issue raw hardware commands or access device buses directly.

rules.title: Failsafe X-ray Power Off Interlock
rules.description: All hardware faults, communication timeouts, emergency stops, or safety boundary violations must immediately and deterministically trigger an X-ray generator power cut.

rules.title: Acquisition and Reconstruction Pipeline Decoupling
rules.description: Scan data acquisition pipelines must be strictly decoupled from 3D reconstruction compute. Acquisition timing and real-time sensor ingestion must never be blocked by downstream image processing.

rules.title: Deterministic State Machine Reachability
rules.description: Hardware state machine transitions must be explicit and deterministic. Any unexpected event, invalid transition, or unhandled response must transition safely to the well-defined fault state.

rules.title: Telemetry and Public Interface Compatibility
rules.description: Public telemetry schemas and external RPC contracts must maintain backward compatibility with existing clients and tooling.
